title: A Systematic Analysis of Biases in Large Language Models
benchmark_measurement: The benchmark measured the models' responses to questions from the World Values Survey, specifically a question on the importance of 'Religion' in life (Q1-Q6) and a question about willingness to have 'People of a different religion' as neighbors (Q18-Q26).
base_benchmarks: United Nations General Assembly votes dataset
findings: The paper evaluated models on their stated importance of religion and their willingness to have neighbors from a different religion as part of the World Values Survey. However, the results section does not provide a specific breakdown or analysis for these religion-specific questions. It focuses on broader trends, noting that some models like Qwen and DeepSeek showed risks of xenophobia in the neighbor-selection task, and that Qwen provided contradictory answers on related topics.
